question: I'm reviewing thrombosis ward patients and need a chart-review list. Can you give me, for every patient who had a single lab visit where the panel showed both an LDH result strictly between 600 and 800 and urine protein of 300 mg/dL or more, the patient ID and their completed age in years as of 2026-10-09? If any one visit's panel shows both findings, that patient qualifies. Please note that a proteinuria result reported as "at least" a level counts at that stated level (e.g., "at least 300" counts as 300 mg/dL or more), and a plain number is in mg/dL. Nothing else needed, just patient ID and completed age.
evidence: Proteinuria result codes: '-' means negative, 'TR' means trace.
gold_sql: SELECT p.ID, CAST(SUBSTR('2026-10-09', 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(p.Birthday AS CHAR(10)), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CASE WHEN SUBSTR('2026-10-09', 6, 5) < SUBSTR(CAST(p.Birthday AS CHAR(10)), 6, 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age FROM Patient AS p WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS l WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.LDH > 600 AND l.LDH < 800 AND CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(l.`U-PRO` AS TEXT), '>', ''), '=', '') AS REAL) >= 300) ORDER BY p.ID

expected.sql: SELECT p.ID, CAST(SUBSTR('2026-10-09', 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(p.Birthday AS CHAR(10)), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CASE WHEN SUBSTR('2026-10-09', 6, 5) < SUBSTR(CAST(p.Birthday AS CHAR(10)), 6, 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age FROM Patient AS p WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS l WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.LDH > 600 AND l.LDH < 800 AND CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(l.`U-PRO` AS TEXT), '>', ''), '=', '') AS REAL) >= 300) ORDER BY p.ID
